canada.title: Man pleads guilty to manslaughter in Saskatoon homicide sparked by missing drugs
canada.summary: Edin Vrazalica's trial for first-degree murder was scheduled to begin Monday. Instead, he pleaded guilty to manslaughter in the February 2024 death of Lee Perkins in Saskatoon.

canada.title: Quebec coroner calls for improvements to REM station fence following deaths of 2 brothers
canada.summary: A Quebec coroner says the REM light-rail network might have to re-evaluate the penetration-resistant fence around Du Quartier station, in Brossard, after two young men were fatally hit by a train there about a year ago.

canada.title: 'A line has been crossed': Verdun borough mayor condemns sexist caricature in local weekly
canada.summary: A weekly newspaper based in Montreal's Nuns' Island has come under fire for distributing a sexist caricature of Céline-Audrey Beauregard, the borough mayor of Verdun.

canada.title: No charges after Manitoba Mountie allows dog to bite man without warning
canada.summary: WINNIPEG - Manitoba’s police oversight agency says no charges will be laid after an officer gave no warning before allowing a police dog to bite a man experiencing a mental health crisis.

canada.title: Federal government spent $19 billion on external consultants last year
canada.summary: OTTAWA - The federal government spent $19 billion on external consultants last year, despite a promise to cut back on its use of outside contractors.

canada.title: Honda Canada announces plans to retool Alliston, Ont., plant for hybrid production
canada.summary: Honda Canada says it will retool its manufacturing facilities in Alliston, Ont., to expand production of hybrid-electric and gasoline-powered vehicles. The Japanese automaker announced Monday it is partnering with the federal and provincial governments to fund plant upgrades, including the reintroduction of engine manufacturing, with an initial $166-million investment.

canada.title: New Brunswick Premier Susan Holt unveils plan to grow exports outside the U.S.
canada.summary: The New Brunswick government wants to expand its export markets outside the United States by almost 16 per cent by 2030.

canada.title: Revamped Mount Sima training facility welcomes record number of elite athletes for pre-season training
canada.summary: Mount Sima's pre-season is breaking attendance records this year as elite athletes from all over are making use of the Whitehorse mountain's training facility. That’s thanks to a newly resurrected T-bar and the addition of a morning training session under floodlights, which means more terrain is available for more hours in the day.

canada.title: On the Outside: Is Manitoba contributing to its own crime problem?
canada.summary: APTN Investigates follows people who have been released by the correctional system to see how Manitoba supports them.

canada.title: Sexton Lumber operations suspended indefinitely nearly 2 weeks after fire
canada.summary: Operations at Newfoundland and Labrador’s largest sawmill are suspended following a late-October fire at its facility in Bloomfield.

canada.title: Art Gallery of Ontario to open 5-floor expansion in September 2027
canada.summary: The Toronto museum says the Dani Reiss Modern and Contemporary Gallery will display nearly 400 artworks by Indigenous, Canadian and international artists.

canada.title: Beaded poppy workshop in Moose Jaw explores history and honours cultural tradition
canada.summary: Originally crafted to celebrate Indigenous culture and veterans, beaded poppies are meant to complement — rather than replace — traditional poppies.

canada.title: Hellebuyck willing to face the music, but Devils say he won't play game in Winnipeg
canada.summary: It was supposed to be the grand, if a little awkward, return of Connor Hellebuyck to Winnipeg, but Jets fans will need to wait until another day to greet or taunt him.

canada.title: Calgary living wage up slightly from last year: report
canada.summary: The Alberta Living Wage Network says Calgary's living wage — or the amount a full-time worker needs to meet their basic needs, manage unexpected expenses and participate meaningfully in their community — is now $26.90, up from $26.50 last year.

canada.title: Third storm heads for already drenched B.C. coast
canada.summary: The third in a series of storms is heading for B.C., after wild weather knocked out power to thousands, triggered evacuations and left one person dead over the weekend.

canada.title: B.C. lab ordered to pay $32K for misgendering transgender, non-binary patients

canada.title: Report on 'critical challenges' in Lloydminster health care released by Alberta, Saskatchewan

rows: The effort will likely fail, but Representative Thomas Massie wants to push Trump to fire Hegseth before Democrats can launch their own impeachment process.
Rep. Thomas Massie on Monday introduced articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, accusing him of waging war against Iran without congressional authorization.
Hegseth said he's "not worried" about an impeachment effort.
US representative accuses defense secretary of illegally waging war without congressional authorization and abusing his powers
The outgoing congressman included eight charges against Hegseth, largely related to the Iran war. A floor vote in the House could come as soon as this week.
